title: Geometric Linguistic Transformations in Transformer Latent Spaces: Research Artifact and Reproducibility Package
description: Archival software and research-artifact snapshot for empirical experiments on linguistic transformation geometry, activation-space final-marker steering, and controlled training-time composition in transformer models. This release preserves code, result tables, figures, draft papers, GLT-STEER source-cluster and corrected token-direction controls, a source-paired bootstrap boundary audit, and GLT-BUILD-02/03 boundary audits. The main readable document is reports/2026-08-25_glt_steer_submission_draft.pdf; draft.md files and the research diary are working research records. It is a reproducibility package and citable research snapshot, not a peer-reviewed publication or a claim of a complete linguistic-operator theory.
